parent_objective: design no-training miner that converts temporal action sensitivity into outcome-critical rows

public_gates: design starts from M719 temporal action-sensitive rows without treating them as outcome proof
design defines local obstacle timing lateral offset or boundary-margin search
acceptance requires temporal action delta and margin/success degradation
source diversity and normal-history retention gates are explicit
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim action-only rows are source-positive outcome rows
do not add oracle labels hidden params or fault labels to actor observations
do not tune obstacle variants after seeing private holdout outcomes

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_action_to_outcome: design boundary mining that tests whether temporal action deltas affect closed-loop margin
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: pre-registers how to turn M719 action-only temporal rows into a no-training outcome-sensitive corpus search
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no new source-positive or checkpoint-promotion claim
stop_condition: stop if local obstacle perturbations merely create impossible normal-history failures
stop if temporal mismatch action deltas do not change margin under boundary scenarios
stop actor mutation until outcome-critical rows are source-diverse
fallback_plan: if outcome-critical rows are found, design source-balanced export and proof/generalization gates
if action deltas remain outcome-neutral, return to actor-head objective design only as action-level diagnostic
if local perturbations are too synthetic, pivot to higher-fidelity dynamics or active probing
if source diversity is weak, mine fresh seeds before objective design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: new branch after M720 promote_to_next_branch decision

hypothesis: M719's temporal action deltas can become outcome-critical near obstacle/boundary decision surfaces; a no-training local boundary miner can find those rows without changing actor inputs or training.
success_criteria: M721 defines source selection from M719 temporal action-critical rows
M721 defines local obstacle/boundary perturbation variables and limits
M721 defines normal-history retention and temporal mismatch outcome gates
no training PPO actor update or promotion occurs
failure_criteria: design treats action-only rows as already outcome-positive
decision_rule: M721 may admit only a no-training M722 miner implementation. It must not admit actor update, PPO, or promotion.
